text: This report discusses the upcoming round of collective bargaining negotiations between the Toronto Zoo and the Toronto Zoo’s Union CUPE Local 1600.

The Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo: 1. Adopted the recommendations in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (November 17, 2020) from the Chief Executive Officer, Toronto Zoo. 2. Directed that Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (November 17, 2020) from the Chief Executive Officer, Toronto Zoo remain confidential in its entirety as it contains information pertaining to labour relations and employee negotiations.
